completion.native300_root_and_fixed32_suffix_parity: Within native300 repeated selected-root parity and within fixed32 suffix free/identity parity; no bitwise endpoint comparison acrossdifferent batch sizes. Actual allocated adapter verification remains UNRESOLVED.
completion.reproduction_scope: Independent NumPy readout/cost/tie reconstruction is not independent model or simulator regeneration.

sources_and_normalizers_lock.semantics: Filled from actual existing immutable sources and heads before the scheduler call; own model and head normalizers retained

decision_cost.primary_exact_ties: Mean realized physical cost over all exactly tied predicted argmin indices (uniform tie expectation).
decision_cost.readout: Same frozen pool g_A decodes candidate terminal and goal-image tokens, with its own saved normalizers.
decision_cost.secondary_ties: Lowest-index exact predicted minimizer; point summary only.

execution_checks.actual_native_runtime: Validated on every retained case; no extra pilot samples
execution_checks.measured_resources: Recorded by actual jobs and latent-pool reports

feedback_family.donor_assignment: One full permutation shared across pools/objectives/conditions; donor uses its own executed prefix.
feedback_family.failure_policy: Retain every attempted solver failure; no failure becomes zero, no family or goal replacement, no partial successful population accepted.
feedback_family.interpretation: Joint T0/T1 matching is a matched decision comparison, not an S2 baseline-only diagnostic or a causal isolation of training/readout changes.
feedback_family.matching: Minimum of all8 projected Euclidean norms in g_A input-standardized coordinates, then one first-accepted shared FP32 shrink for all8.
feedback_family.reset: Full observed-token replacement, a single-token information reference; not a norm-matched intervention or upper bound.
feedback_family.zero_policy: Solve all8; legitimate zero makes the entire family zero and retains all four branches.

freeze_scope: Scientific choices retained from pre-S2-outcome draft. Actual S2 completion and executable paths bound before any S3 generation or inference.

admissibility_source_and_settings.rule: Unchanged original input-only first512 admitted, complete rejection history, max100000 attempts per role

population.isolation_scope: Bound historical/head inputs plus all actually attempted S1/S2 parents, including rejected attempts; retained-pixel content audit; no global pretraining isolation claim.

primary_statistics.aggregation: Equal mean over3pools and2objectives within each recipient, then paired recipient bootstrap
primary_statistics.conditioning: Fixed six model pairs, realized donor bank and fixed donor assignment; models/strata are averaged within each recipient, not treated as independent replications.
primary_statistics.joint_success: Both interval upper bounds are strictly below0
primary_statistics.strictly_positive_interval: Higher selected physical cost under actual guidance
primary_statistics.verification_tolerance_scope: Independent numeric reconstruction only; exact predicted-cost ties keep zero tie tolerance. Fixed on existing precedent and synthetic checks before anyS3effects.

secondary_descriptive_only.inference: Point summaries only; no additional significance claim or secondary interval family
secondary_descriptive_only.selection_change: Mean indicator that exact predicted-cost argmin sets differ between T1 actual and T1 free, with the same recipient/pool/objective weights
secondary_descriptive_only.tie_sensitivity: Selected physical cost using lowest-index among exact tied predicted minima

seed_resolution_scope: Draft seeds resolved by predetermined hash namespace before S2/S3effectaccess;113metadata manifests checked. No generation or scientific execution authorized; actual content isolation and source-freeze remain pending.

shared_prefix_decision.candidate_rule: Existing select_suffix_candidates: selected suffix, zero suffix,30 source indices sampled without replacement; retain duplicate action sequences.
shared_prefix_decision.future_state_access: Predictions/decisions must be sealed before joining separate physical outcomes; code/data-flow separation, not OS access-control claim.
shared_prefix_decision.root_rule: Each C model predicts the same actually executed five-action prefix; actual/donor branches of that model share this root. Other models keep their own roots.
shared_prefix_decision.suffix_root_rule: Exactly one branch root per model, broadcast over the same32 candidates; no candidate-specific feedback.
